submitted.rationale: XRD shows bixbyite In2O3 on the In-rich side (Q 2.15, 2.48, 3.51, 4.11), fading by index 10. Rutile-type InSbO4 (Q ~1.875) appears at index 15 and above, and a minor Sb-oxide peak (Q 2.67) shows up at index 21. The peaks at Q 2.79, 4.55 and 5.33 are in every pattern, so they are likely from the substrate. EQE fell from 0.087% at index 15 to 0.051% at index 21, so I moved toward the In-rich side. Index 12 (In0.60Sb0.40), near the In2O3/InSbO4 phase boundary, gave the highest EQE: 0.101%.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.051%. EQE falls as Sb increases.
EQE was falling with more Sb, and there was no merit budget left to test it.
